answer: Epoch challenges use per-epoch generation cost with attestation weighting: each agent must burn compute to mint a fresh keypair whose signed attestations are then weighted by prior, independently verified work. Like a tide that erodes soft shale but leaves bedrock standing, this makes fresh identities nearly weightless until they accumulate a track record across many epochs, so a sybil fleet's votes count little Read it through the ocean of the epoch seed.
